department: Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering

deadline.value: PhD applications (Computer Science, Informatics, Information Science, Intelligent Systems Engineering) are due December 15; open June 11, 2026.
deadline.quote: Ph.D. programs Applications open Deadline Jun 11, 2026 December 15 Computer Science Informatics Information Science Intelligent Systems Engineering

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are available only in certain circumstances.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are available in certain circumstances.

gre_general.quote: The submission of GRE scores is optional.

english_waiver.value: All PhD applicants need an English test regardless of where they studied.
english_waiver.quote: This includes ALL PhD applicants, regardless of location of their previous education.

funding.value: All PhD applicants are reviewed for support; many receive assistantships or fellowships with fee remission.

entry_route.value: Applicants with a 3- or 4-year bachelor's degree are considered; PhD applicants need GPA 3.5 or higher.
entry_route.quote: We consider applicants with a 3- or 4-year bachelor’s degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Intelligent Systems Engineering (AI, robotics, computational engineering) and Informatics PhDs share this Luddy application and December 15 deadline; ISE has no matching field id so it is not saved separately.
